# EPAM Campus

> > Free, industry-focused IT training platform offering 30+ learning paths from beginner to junior developer levels across programming, cloud, data, and QA specializations.

EPAM Campus is a comprehensive learning platform providing free courses, career guidance, and events for aspiring IT professionals worldwide. The platform covers core programming languages (Java, Python, JavaScript, .NET), cloud infrastructure (AWS, DevOps), data science, QA automation, and enterprise technologies (SAP), with structured career roadmaps and expert-led content.

## Getting Started

- [Industry-focused free IT courses for beginners | EPAM Campus](https://campus.epam.com/en): EPAM Campus homepage: free IT training in 30+ directions for beginners worldwide
- [Online IT courses: choose a program for your skill level | EPAM Campus](https://campus.epam.com/en/training): EPAM training programs catalog with courses for various skill levels and IT directions
- [Education within the IT company | EPAM Campus](https://campus.epam.com/en/about): About EPAM Campus: training programs and learning platform overview for IT professionals
- [Pass a career test and discover which tech job is the best fit for you | EPAM Campus](https://campus.epam.com/en/career-test/guidance): Career guidance test to match personality with IT professions and learning paths

## Programming Language Roadmaps

- [How to become a Junior Java Developer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/Java): Java developer career roadmap with free courses for junior-level backend development
- [How to become a Junior Python Developer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/Python): Python fundamentals guide for junior developers in web and data science fields
- [How to become a Junior JavaScript developer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/JavaScript): JavaScript front-end developer guide with frameworks: React, Angular, Vue training
- [How to become .NET Developer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/NET): .NET and C# development guide for junior enterprise application developers

## Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure

- [How to become a Cloud & DevOps engineer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/CloudAndDevOps): Cloud and DevOps engineer roadmap with Git, Bash, infrastructure automation training
- [How to become AWS Cloud Engineer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/AWS): AWS cloud engineer guide by EPAM Premier Partner with certification and infrastructure skills

## Data & Analytics Specializations

- [How to start in Data Science? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/DataScience): Data science beginner guide with Python, SQL, Pandas for machine learning careers
- [How to become a Junior Data Analysis Engineer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/DataAnalyticsEngineering): Data analytics engineer path with data quality, visualization, and integration skills

## Quality Assurance & Testing

- [How to become Junior Test Automation Engineer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/AutomatedTesting): Test automation engineer guide using Java, Python, JavaScript, C# for QA careers
- [How to become Junior Software Test Engineer? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/SoftwareTesting): Manual testing and QA career path for junior test engineers with VIVIDUS training

## Business & Enterprise Roles

- [How to become a Business Analyst? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/BusinessAnalysis): Business analyst career guide with requirements analysis and stakeholder communication
- [How to become an SAP specialist? | EPAM](https://campus.epam.com/en/skill/SAP): SAP specialist training with ERP, ABAP, and SAP ECC for enterprise business processes
